coverage: pause and shared broadcast without new creation
audio prepared ahead while the real AudioContext runs

limitations: Buffer size is usable content, not a guaranteed startup time or maximum delay.
Decision deadline remains sixty seconds; a slow model or Speech service can exhaust the reserve.
Narration is selective, with silence and omitted routine interventions; full narration is preserved in prepared replay.
A paused viewer falls behind; manual reconnection obtains a new snapshot near the available frontier.
Encounters shorter than twenty seconds can finish before buffered playback starts.
Speech/pitch alignment is per intervention, not per word.
Browser audio regression uses short fixture audio; public real-Speech verification is pending.
